cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: _______ very important to analyze the inflation data every month.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: En español el sujeto es tácito ('Es importante'), pero en inglés toda oración requiere un pronombre sujeto explícito ('It is important').

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: The investment return depends _______ market volatility and consumer confidence.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: En español decimos 'depende de', pero en inglés el régimen verbal obligatorio es 'depend ON'.

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: Our quantitative research team is very interested _______ analyzing time-series datasets.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: El adjetivo 'interested' siempre rige la preposición 'IN' seguida de gerundio (interested in analyzing).

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: The government adopted a new fiscal _______ to curb the escalating debt deficit.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: Falso amigo crítico: 'Policy' es la política pública o plan de acción institucional; 'Politics' es la actividad política o partidista.

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: By the time the central bank raised rates, prices _______ by more than 8%.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: Uso del Past Perfect ('had surged') para indicar una acción anterior a otro evento en el pasado ('raised').

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: After months of negotiations, the two central banks _______ reached a currency swap agreement.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: Falso amigo: 'Eventually' significa 'finalmente' o 'a la larga'. 'Actually' significa 'en realidad/de hecho' (no actualmente).

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: Under no circumstances _______ the central bank allow hyperinflation expectations to unanchor.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: Inversión sintáctica negativa formal: tras 'Under no circumstances' se invierte el orden auxiliar + sujeto ('will the central bank allow').

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: To account for unobserved time-invariant confounders, we estimate a model with two-way _______ effects.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: En econometría empírica, 'Two-way fixed effects' (TWFE) es el estándar canónico para controlar por heterogeneidad no observada de entidad y tiempo.

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: Given that the explanatory variable is endogenous, we exploit a rainfall shock as an _______ variable.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: 'Instrumental Variables' (IV) es la terminología técnica para resolver problemas de endogeneidad y correlación con el término de error.

cloze_questions.sentence_with_blank: The empirical findings _______ that credit friction exacerbates macroeconomic downturns.
cloze_questions.contrastive_tip_es: En redacción académica internacional (Academic Hedging), se prefiere 'suggest / indicate' para matizar conclusiones empíricas en lugar de afirmaciones categóricas como 'proves definitively'.

listening_questions.audio_text: The Federal Reserve chairman announced that inflation dropped to 3 percent this quarter, easing concerns among private investors.
listening_questions.question_text: What was the main outcome announced regarding inflation?
options: It dropped to 3%, decreasing investor concern
It surged above target, causing panic
It remained completely flat all year
It doubled due to higher gas prices
listening_questions.correct_option: It dropped to 3%, decreasing investor concern

listening_questions.audio_text: Although consumer expenditure rebounded slightly last month, business fixed investment plateaued due to elevated borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty.
listening_questions.question_text: Why did business fixed investment remain flat (plateaued)?
options: High borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty
A sharp decline in consumer expenditure
A sudden cut in central bank interest rates
listening_questions.correct_option: High borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty

listening_questions.audio_text: In our baseline two-stage least squares specification, the first-stage F-statistic comfortably exceeds the standard Stock-Yogo threshold of ten, dispelling weak instrument apprehensions.
listening_questions.question_text: What does the first-stage F-statistic exceeding ten indicate?
options: The instruments used are sufficiently strong
The econometric model suffers from severe multicollinearity
The sample size is too small for statistical power
The null hypothesis of zero effect was rejected
listening_questions.correct_option: The instruments used are sufficiently strong

economics_questions.definition_prompt: Which concept measures the percentage change in quantity demanded in response to a percentage change in price?
economics_questions.example_usage: When price elasticity is greater than one, demand is deemed elastic.

economics_questions.definition_prompt: What phenomenon occurs when short-term sovereign bond yields exceed long-term yields, traditionally signaling a recession?
economics_questions.example_usage: An inverted yield curve has preceded nearly every major modern economic downturn.

economics_questions.definition_prompt: What econometric issue arises when an explanatory variable is correlated with the error term?
economics_questions.example_usage: Omitted variable bias and reverse causality are the leading causes of endogeneity.

economics_questions.definition_prompt: What asymmetric information condition occurs when one party takes greater risks because another party bears the costs?
economics_questions.example_usage: Government bailouts can induce moral hazard among large financial institutions.

spoken_prompt.instructions_en: You have 60 seconds. Describe how a central bank should respond when core inflation rises while GDP growth slows down. Use academic/economic vocabulary.
spoken_prompt.instructions_es: Tienes 60 segundos. Explica en inglés cómo debe responder un banco central cuando la inflación subyacente aumenta pero el PIB se desacelera.
